data.name: EcoFix
data.description: EcoFix Kenya Ltd (formerly Eco Fuels Kenya) is a Nanyuki-based social enterprise that processes Croton megalocarpus nuts into biofuel, animal feed, organic fertilizer, and cosmetics, sourcing from ~6,000 smallholder farmers. Through a 2025 partnership with Terraton, its nut-processing residues are being converted into biochar, with a facility currently under review with Isometric. Biochar/CDR is an adjacent activity layered onto EcoFix's core agribusiness, which would continue to exist without the CDR stream.
